name: London Project shared global Coupang pool v7
selection_principles: All enabled blogs and future registered domains draw from one shared global Coupang product pool; do not create isolated site catalogs by default.
Every published article receives exactly 10 Coupang Partners product cards with account-generated tracking URLs and official Coupang images.
Initial shared catalog target is 200 offers: 40 K-Beauty, 40 K-Electronics, 40 K-Health, 30 Korea Travel, 30 Korea Hotels, 20 K-Lifestyle.

Per-article target mix: 2 beauty, 2 electronics, 2 health supplements, 1 Korea travel, 1 Korea hotel, 2 lifestyle. If a category has no eligible products, backfill with the strongest remaining verified products and record the shortfall.

Products are selected by article relevance, genuine popularity/review evidence, and deterministic rotation keyed by domain and post ID. A post keeps a stable selection; different posts should not all repeat the same ten items.
Use only account-generated Coupang Partners tracking URLs and official product images. Never invent links, products, images, prices, sales, reviews, or commissions.
Prioritize broadly appealing, credible products and mid-to-premium price points. Avoid low-price filler. Health products must not carry unsupported treatment or prevention claims.

Hotel and travel package inventory must be real purchasable Coupang offers with valid tracking links. If no eligible offer exists, report the shortage; never invent or substitute a non-Coupang booking link.
Preserve editorial body, status, publication date, featured image and SEO metadata; replace only the designated affiliate block.
Apply to both existing published articles (backfill) and new articles before publication, after catalog and destination verification.
